role: Keeps a living's body (renderYawOffset) behind its head (rotationYawHead) so the model turns smoothly: the moving case snaps the body to the yaw, the standing case eases it and after 10 still ticks widens the allowed lag.
scope_reason: renderYawOffset and rotationYawHead are recorded state on the livings the digests compare.
